{{Quote|For the den! For Corellia!|Murthil rallies her Guard|<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />}}
The '''Elite Selonian Guard''' was a group of [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] who served as the elite [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of the [[Murthil's den|den]] leader [[Murthil]].<ref name="Selonian Uprising" /> By [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> [[Destha]] was a member of the Guard, and [[Gender/Legends|she]] and a handful of other Selonian Guards accompanied Murthil in the latter's bunker at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith-Imperial]] strike force's arrival there. The two sides [[Battle of Corellia#War begins|battled]], and the Guard members were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an Imperial hero who proceeded to dispatch of Murthil, thus ending her den's efforts to resist Imperial rule.<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
In cutscenes of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', three Elite Selonian Guards could be seen alongside Destha and Murthil. However, in the game environment itself, only two members of the Elite Selonian Guard existed alongside Destha and Murthil.<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />
